Metadata.CommitMsg:
fix(review): align encryption header, per-sink channels, safe cleanup

- fix(encrypt): write ENCLOG1\0 header + version + algo so library-encrypted
  files are decryptable by the CLI tool (was nonce+ciphertext only, breaking
  the documented format in docs/SECURITY.md and CLI decrypt_file_compatible)
- fix(routing): give each enabled async sink its own channel; sharing one MPMC
  channel meant every record was consumed by a single worker, silently losing
  data for the other sinks when file+db were both enabled
- fix(cleanup): only delete rotated sibling log files sorted by mtime; never
  delete unrelated files or the active log file; expiry now keeps the newest
  keep_files and never removes fresh logs
- test: interop test proves CLI decrypts library-encrypted files; regression
  tests for unrelated-file safety and keep_files boundary
